survey: Image 5 is a broom shown at a diagonal against a flat wavy blue background. Its parts: (1) A straight, round wooden handle with a rounded knob at the top end. It runs from the upper right to the lower left. (2) At the lower end, the handle goes into a tight bundle of straw. The straw is gathered into a collar around the handle and then fans out into a bell-shaped sweeping head with uneven, slightly flared bristle tips. (3) A red cord is wrapped about three times around the gathered straw just below the collar. It binds the bundle to the handle the way real broom lashing does. The cord shows as closed coils with no loose ends trailing off. The broom floats on a plain icon background with no ground, which is normal for an item card. The handle is one piece with one end cap. The straw clearly surrounds the handle end, so the head is attached. The broom could sweep.
